topics.label: Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by connecting to histopathology practicals and outlining the key learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor Virology and the Discovery of Cellular Proto-Oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the historical study of infectious tumor viruses that led to the discovery that oncogenes originate from normal cellular genes.

topics.label: Functional Assays, Classifications, and Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer-associated genes are experimentally assayed, categorized into oncogenes or tumor suppressors, and mechanistically alter cell cycle regulation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Cellular Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the repair failures and mitotic errors that generate sequence instability and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multistep Tumor Progression and Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the stepwise accumulation and inheritance of genetic mutations drive cancer development and subsequent tumor evolution.
